description: newsroom-pets: agent.spawn maps a reporter's agentId from its dispatch prompt; tool.call (every tool) classifies the call into an action (actions.ts) and its outcome (blocked, red or green gate); a 320 ms frame timer runs while anyone is on stage and drops to 900 ms otherwise; ui.render on AbovePrompt draws the desks, or a 2-row napping/thinking editor, and keeps what later mods draw. Every hook passes next(e) through unchanged.
